modules.name: turbine-mod-manager
build-commands: if [ -d /run/ccache ]; then export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/run/ccache/cargo-target; fi; cargo --offline build --release --locked -p turbine-mod-manager && install -Dm755 "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/release/turbine-mod-manager" /app/bin/turbine-mod-manager
for d in vendor/libloot vendor/libloot-*; do if [ -f "$d/LICENSE" ]; then install -Dm644 "$d/LICENSE" /app/share/turbine-mod-manager/licenses/libloot-LICENSE.txt; fi; done
mkdir -p /app/share/turbine-mod-manager/extension && cd extension && for f in *; do if [ "$f" != test ]; then cp -r "$f" /app/share/turbine-mod-manager/extension/; fi; done
for s in turbine coop; do install -Dm644 -t /app/share/turbine-mod-manager/steam-art/$s packaging/steam-art/$s/*.png; done
for n in 32 48 64 128 256 512; do install -Dm644 packaging/io.github.ravenor907.TurbineModManager-$n.png /app/share/icons/hicolor/${n}x${n}/apps/io.github.ravenor907.TurbineModManager.png; done
